ipa.surfaces.fx.FxCalculationParams

This class property contains the properties that may be used to control the calculation. It mainly covers dates, market data assumptions (e.g. interpolation), and pricing model preferences. Some Parameters are common to all volatility surfaces contracts, while others are specific to a particular type of volatility.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.surfaces.fx.FxCalculationParams.

Syntax

FxSurfaceParameters(
    *,
    atm_volatility_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    butterfly10_d_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    butterfly25_d_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    domestic_deposit_rate_percent_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    foreign_deposit_rate_percent_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    forward_points_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    fx_spot_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    fx_swap_calculation_method: FxSwapCalculationMethod | None = None,
    implied_volatility_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    interpolation_weight: InterpolationWeight | None = None,
    price_side: PriceSide | None = None,
    risk_reversal10_d_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    risk_reversal25_d_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    time_stamp: TimeStamp | None = None,
    volatility_model: FxVolatilityModel | None = None,
    x_axis: Axis | None = None,
    y_axis: Axis | None = None,
    calculation_date: OptDateTime = None,
    cutoff_time: str | None = None,
    cutoff_time_zone: str | None = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
atm_volatility_object BidAskMid | None No None
butterfly10_d_object BidAskMid | None No None
butterfly25_d_object BidAskMid | None No None
domestic_deposit_rate_percent_object BidAskMid | None No None
foreign_deposit_rate_percent_object BidAskMid | None No None
forward_points_object BidAskMid | None No None
fx_spot_object BidAskMid | None No None
fx_swap_calculation_method FxSwapCalculationMethod | None No None The method used to calculate an outright price or deposit rates. The possible values are: FxSwapImpliedFromDeposit: implied FX swap points are computed from deposit rates, DepositCcy1ImpliedFromFxSwap: the currency 1 deposit rates are computed using swap points, DepositCcy2ImpliedFromFxSwap: the currency 2 deposit rates are computed using swap points.
implied_volatility_object BidAskMid | None No None
interpolation_weight InterpolationWeight | None No None
price_side PriceSide | None No None Specifies whether bid, ask, mid or settle is used to build the surface. if not precised, default to mid.
risk_reversal10_d_object BidAskMid | None No None
risk_reversal25_d_object BidAskMid | None No None
time_stamp TimeStamp | None No None Define how the timestamp is selected:
- open: the opening value of the valuationdate or if not available the close of
the previous day is used.
- default: the latest snapshot is used when valuationdate is today, the close
price when valuationdate is in the past.
volatility_model FxVolatilityModel | None No None The quantitative model used to generate the volatility surface. this may depend on the asset class. for fx volatility surface, we currently support the svi model.
x_axis Axis | None No None Specifies the unit for the x axis (e.g. date, tenor)
y_axis Axis | None No None Specifies the unit for the y axis (e.g. strike, delta). this may depend on the asset class. for fx volatility surface, we support both delta and strike.
calculation_date OptDateTime No None The date the volatility surface is generated.
cutoff_time str | None No None The cutoff time
cutoff_time_zone str | None No None The cutoff time zone
